inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: There was no record of smoke detector testing available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §747.5115)

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: There was no record of inspection of fire extinguisher available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §747.5107(a))

occurrences.finding: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Documentation Available During Hours of Operation: There was no documentation of carbon monoxide detector testing available for review during the  inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Documentation Available During Hours of Operation (26 TAC §747.5337(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: Records for 9 children enrolled was reviewed. All 9 children did not have a health statement signed by a parent or health care professional. 2 of the 9 did not have emerngecy medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment: There was no parental notification of liability insurance available to review in the children's files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §747.213(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Half of the fence in the outdoor area was observed to have fallen down.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training: Substitute caregiver's annual trainings were not available to review during the inspection time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: CPR/First Aid trainigs for primary caregiver and subtitute caregiver were not available to review during the inspection time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Half of the fence in the outdoor area was observed to have fallen down.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: There was a six months old infant observed to be sleeping with two blankets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §747.2309(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training: Substitute caregiver's annual trainings were not available to review during the inspection time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: A six months infant was observed sleeping with a bottle that was hold by a blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §747.2319(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: CPR/First Aid trainigs for primary caregiver and subtitute caregiver were not available to review during the inspection time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: There was a person helping to care for the children in the home without a background check in the system.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Supervision was not maintained when a ten year old child was observed in the upstairs of the home while the rest of the children were napping downstair in the living room.    It was corrected at the inspection time when the child was moved with the rest of the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment: There was no parental notification of liability insurance available to review in the children's files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §747.213(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-License: The operation did not had the licensed childcare center permit certificate posted for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-License (26 TAC §747.401(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-List of Employees: The operation did not had the employee list posted for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-List of Employees (26 TAC §747.401(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did not complete their annual children product certification since 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training: Two operational staff files were review.  One out of the two operational staff did not had the annual 24 hours of training for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Twelve children files were review. Two out of the twelve children files did not have Emergency Medical Authorization fill out properly and correctly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: The operation did not had 2936 inspection form posted for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler: Sippy cups were observed not properly labeled with children first name and first initial of last name. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver was observed labeling the sippy cups.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler (26 TAC §747.2405(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: Children were observed having screen time while eating a snack. This was corrected during the inspection when the television was observed being turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records: There was no record available for review during inspection for one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records (26 TAC §747.901)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Outdoor play area was observed having broken and missing pickets on the gate. A wheel barrow and two barbeque pits were observed accessible to children in the backyard play area. A lighter and two bottles of lighter fluid was observed on a table in the backyard accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: There were no documentation of emergency drills including fire drills, fire extinguisher, smoke detector, and carbon monoxide detector available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Four children under the age of 2 years old was observed having screen time during the inspection. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver was observed turning the television off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that children are being made to nap as a form of punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §747.2705(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive Device for Time Out: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that children are being placed in a highchair as a form of punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive Device for Time Out (26 TAC §747.2705(8))

occurrences.finding: HRC42.044 - Inspections and Investigations Allowed: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that the DFPS investigator was not allowed entrance into the operation to conduct the investigation and was denied access to a child's record when requested.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC42.044 - Inspections and Investigations Allowed (26 TAC §HRC42.044 - Inspections and Investigatio)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a citation that diapers are not promptly changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §747.3301(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a citation for prohibited punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §747.2705(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegation that diaper changing supplies were in which of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §747.3301(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: As of today September 16th, 2022, the provider has not submitted documentation for 2  children's records that were evaluated and did not contain current immunizations. The most recent immunizations were from 2019.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Record Upon Admission: As of today September 16th, 2022 the provider has not submitted documentation for 2 children's records that were evaluated and was missing documentation of immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Record Upon Admission (26 TAC §747.613(c))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: As of September 16th, 2022 the provider still has not provided a written policy for the Promotion of Physical Activity which include the following:      (A)The duration of physical activity at your home, both indoor and outdoor   (B)The recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physical activities   (C) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: As of today September 16th, 2022 the provider still has not submitted documentation for 3 children's records that were evaluated and was missing information including the following:    Name and Phone Number of Release Person  Complete Emergency Contact Information
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: As of today September 16th, 2022 the provider still has  not submitted health statements for 2 children's records that were evaluated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 7 out of 10 chidlren's records evaluated were missing information including the following:    Name and Phone Number of Release Person  Special Needs Statement was left Blank  Complete Emergency Contact Information
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children under 2 years old was observed watching television during the inspection.    Note: Discussed using other activities for children under 2.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: Promotion of Physical Activity at the home was not available for review upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Record Upon Admission: 2 out of 11 children's records evaluated were missing documentation of immunziations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Record Upon Admission (26 TAC §747.613(c))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired: During the inspection a fence observed in the outdoor play area there were two plats missing and the fence is leaning to the side posing a safety hazard for children. There is also an ant bed outside in the play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §747.4407(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 2 out of 11 children's records evaluated did not contain documentation of immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: The health statement was missing for 3 out of 11 children's records evaluated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Criteria - Certificate: Training certificates showing 24 hours of training topics have been completed was not availale for review upon request for the pirmary caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Criteria - Certificate (26 TAC §747.1315(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation - Use Sanitary Holders: Children were observed eating graham crackers on a bare table with no sanitary holder.    Note: The provider corrected this during the inspection by providing napkins for each child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §747.3117(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants: A Safe Sleep Policy for infants under 12 months was not available for review upon request.    Note: Provided the Safe Sleep Policy form to the operation during the inspection where a copy was made and added to the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants (26 TAC §747.501(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training: Documentation of the full 24 hours of annual training for 2 caregivers was not available for review upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During DFPS investigation it was determined that a person had access to  children and did not have a cleared background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
